title: Phase 0: bootstrap repo, toolchain, security baseline
description: git init, .gitignore (excludes .env), Electron+Vite+React19+TS+Tailwind v4 scaffold, Vitest (main/renderer projects), ESLint, Playwright e2e harness, bd init, CLAUDE.md. Security: sandboxed/isolated window, CSP connect-src self, navigation + window-open guards, permission requests denied; copied ipcSecurity/atomicFileWrite/logger from Vangard.
close_reason: Bootstrap complete: npm run gate green (57 unit, 4 e2e)

title: Phase 1: projects and storage
description: Create/open/recent VRS projects (folder: vrs.json, tree.json, docs/*.md, chats/*.json, assets/, bible/*.json, maps/). Schema versioning + migrations. Path-guarded fs IPC (validateProjectPath + atomicWriteFile), vetted project roots via dialog. Save + dirty tracking, crash-recovery snapshots, external-change watcher. Storage layer takes a root so a shared library can come later.
notes: Plan: main-process modules in electron/lib (projectSchema = versioning+migrations, projectStore = create/open/readDoc/save with atomic writes, write order docs->tree->vrs.json and deletes last; recentProjects in userData; recoveryStore = per-project snapshot in userData/recovery; projectWatcher = fs.watch recursive, self-writes filtered by content hash). Vetted roots: current project root is only ever set from a dialog result or an entry in the recents list (which only dialog results populate). IPC project:* + dialog for unsaved prompts. Renderer: pure project reducer + useProject hook, Welcome screen (new/open/recent), minimal stand-in project view (doc list + plain editor) until Phase 2 ports the binder. E2E: VRS_USER_DATA_DIR env override; dialogs stubbed via electronApp.evaluate. Tests: unit for each lib module + reducer, component tests for welcome/project view, e2e create->save->relaunch->persist and external edit pickup.
close_reason: Projects and storage done: schema+migrations, vetted roots, atomic ordered saves, dirty tracking, crash recovery, external-change watcher. Gate green (193 unit, 9 e2e).

Fix prototype bugs: chat editor not keyed by item id, stale AddItemModal defaults, stale QuickRef snapshot, duplicate ignores descendants/id collisions, denormalized reference titles, split-pane divider, per-keystroke whole-list rewrites.
notes: From Phase 1: replace src/components/ProjectWorkspace.tsx (stand-in) with the ported binder/editor; keep using useProject (src/project). The external-change handler in useProject only reacts to docs/*.md, tree.json and vrs.json -- extend it for chats/ and assets/ when those item types land. Media import must go through a main-process handler that writes under the session root.

Not ported on purpose: chat (Phase 4), Map Studio (Phase 6), sample presets and JSON backup import (a project is already plain files). PDF items filed separately. Gate green (274 unit, 12 e2e).

title: Phase 3: manual story bible (no AI)
description: Manual story bible (no AI). Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-17-story-bible-design.md; plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-17-story-bible.md. Entities (character, location, faction, item, lore, event, plotline) as binder items; facts with provenance (source passage offsets + quote); statuses proposed/kept/set_aside; deterministic contradiction detection (same entity + attribute, different values) with a side-by-side conflict queue (Keep this one / Keep both, stored decisions, Reopen). Events with story position (season/episode/order) and must-come-after dependencies; browsable timeline. Read-only chat import (paste or .txt/.md) with capture-by-selection. Story-bible section in the Markdown export. Routes and route-scoped canon were DROPPED (routes belong to the VN-writing app).
close_reason: Story bible implemented on feature/vrs-063.4-story-bible (spec+plan in docs/superpowers); gate green: 399 unit, 14 e2e.

title: AI keys: in-app recovery when ai-keys.json is corrupt or unreadable
description: A corrupt/unreadable userData/ai-keys.json makes has/get/set/remove throw (by design, so keys are never silently overwritten). getStatus reports keyStoreProblem and Settings shows it, but saveKey/removeKey also fail, so the user must delete the file by hand. Add a 'Reset stored keys' action that backs up the corrupt file (ai-keys.json.corrupt-<ts>) and starts fresh. From vrs-063.5 ruling R3.
close_reason: Settings 'Reset stored keys' backs up the unreadable store and starts fresh

title: AI chat: mark truncated replies (max tokens / pause_turn / response.incomplete)
description: Adapters end a reply with a normal done even when the provider stopped early: Anthropic stop_reason max_tokens/pause_turn (server-tool turns), OpenAI response.incomplete, Gemini finishReason MAX_TOKENS. Add an optional truncated reason to the done event, store it on the message, and show a badge ('Reply cut short') in ChatMessageView. From vrs-063.5 Tasks 4-5 review minors.
close_reason: Done on feature/vrs-063.16-19-crlf-truncated; gate green (875 unit, 27 e2e).

title: Fact capture in CRLF documents: quotes spanning a line break resolve as missing until re-saved
description: Documents saved with CRLF (or CR) line endings, e.g. edited outside VRS on Windows, are loaded as-is, but the editor textarea reports LF-only text. Offsets and quotes captured from the editor are LF-based, so resolveSource against the CRLF body fails for any quote spanning a line break (missing) until the document is edited and re-saved. Fix: normalize bodies read from disk (CRLF/CR -> LF, strip BOM) at the renderer readDoc chokepoint.
close_reason: Done on feature/vrs-063.16-19-crlf-truncated; gate green (875 unit, 27 e2e).
